parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The key of the tag that is added to the agent configuration policy.

parameters.name: TagExt
parameters.description: The extended tag of the agent configuration policy.

parameters.name: TagValue
parameters.description:
The value of the tag that is added to the agent configuration policy.

*   major
*   advanced
*   basic

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the server that you want to query.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description: The UUID of the asset. You can specify a maximum of 500 UUIDs at a time.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-client-conf-strategy --uuid 4fe8e1cd-3c37-4851-b9de-124da32c0000 --tag machineResource --tag-value advanced --tag-ext auto --uuids 07a1300d-2198-4d0d-b1b3-c8da205e0000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyClientConfStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --Uuid '4fe8e1cd-3c37-4851-b9de-124da32c0000' --Uuids.1 '07a1300d-2198-4d0d-b1b3-c8da205e0000' --TagExt auto --Tag machineResource --TagValue advanced
